preamble: The shift from [ə] to [i] often occurs through vowel coloring from neighboring palatal consonants or as a process known as 'Happy-tensing', where a final reduced vowel is strengthened and raised.

examples.note: Final reduced vowel strengthening in many modern dialects.
Strengthening of the 'soft jer' (a schwa-like ultra-short vowel) in stressed positions.
